decisions.reason: The COVID-19 collapse in air travel kept the app's value unresolved rather than disproving it, and as software it costs little to keep while air traffic recovers in 2022 and contactless processing gains appeal.
PassBoard was the firm's showcase launch in passenger processing and its value depends on the post-pandemic aviation rebound, so with few comparable options the firm keeps this cheap option open.

Self-service check-in fits airlines' push for efficiency and touchless travel after COVID, the uncertainty about its value has not yet resolved, and keeping it costs little, so it stays on the market.
